confidence_notes: Numbeo's June 2026 Abu Dhabi prices support the meal, cappuccino and domestic-draft estimates. Expedia showed seasonal 2026 averages for common 3-star properties, while hostel prices were displayed as starting rates and provide limited evidence of annual prices including fees. The one-star room estimate is uncertain. Cocktail and wine estimates use about 1.4x and 1.25x the local draft-beer price, respectively.
comparable_city_reasoning: Used Abu Dhabi prices directly; no comparable city was needed.
